scope: raw hybrid probability; complete singleton coverage; unique 2-3 word deletions
selection_warning: Previously inspected corpus cases; not final independent validation
distinction: Anchored Ridge and single-deletion baselines are not the standard LIME estimator. All-word fidelity cannot be attributed to a shortened eight-word explanation. Logodds weights explain logit(p), clipped at 1e-6; fidelity is evaluated after sigmoid on raw probabilities.
